name: Breakfast with Santa at The Center
cost: Adults $30, children 2 to 10 $15, ages 2 and under free
paras: The Center Events and Catering hosts Breakfast with Santa on Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 9 to 11 AM at 4157 Hudson Dr in Stow. The morning pairs a breakfast with photos with Santa and holiday fun for the whole family.
Admission is $30 for adults and $15 for children ages 2 to 10, and children ages 2 and under are free. Tickets went on sale November 14 through the venue.
tip: Buy tickets through The Center before the day, since the breakfast is ticketed.

name: Sensory Friendly Santa and the Symphony
address: 100 E Dublin-Granville Rd, New Albany, OH 43054
paras: The New Albany Symphony Orchestra presents a sensory friendly Santa and the Symphony on Saturday, December 19, 2026, at 11:30 AM at the McCoy Center for the Arts, 100 E Dublin-Granville Rd. The morning features sleigh bells, classic carols and a special visit from Santa.

The sensory friendly series is designed for people on the autism spectrum, the dementia and Alzheimer's community, young children, and anyone who wants a more relaxed concert. Admission is $10 and tickets are sold through CAPA.
tip: Choose this one for a relaxed concert where movement and noise are welcome.
